```python
# Find all roommates (handles pagination)
roommates = []
page = 0
while True:
    batch = apis.phone.search_contacts(
        access_token=phone_token, query="roommate", relationship="roommate", page_index=page
    )
    roommates.extend(batch)
    if len(batch) < 20:  # typical page size
        break
    page += 1
emails = {c['email'] for c in roommates}
```
